a.xlink:title: --- variables: BUILD_TYPE: optimized script: - echo "Building application with overrides..." - echo "Build type: ${BUILD_TYPE}" - mkdir -p build - echo "app-v${VERSION}-optimized" > build/app.txt - echo "Build completed with custom configuration" after_script: - echo "Custom post-build step" - ls -la build/

--- allow_failure: true script: - echo "Running integration tests (with override)..." - echo "Test suite: Integration Tests (Extended)" - echo "Running additional smoke tests..." - echo "Tests passed: 50/50" - echo "All integration tests passed"

--- stage: test script: - echo "Running code quality checks..." - echo "Analyzing code style..." - echo "Checking for code smells..." - echo "Quality score: A+" dependencies: - build-app allow_failure: true

--- before_script: - echo "Preparing production deployment with extra checks..." - echo "Verifying all tests passed..." - echo "Checking deployment prerequisites..." script: - echo "Deploying to production environment (verified)..." - echo "Target: www.example.com" - echo "Running pre-deployment health checks..." - echo "Production deployment completed successfully" after_script: - echo "Running post-deployment verification..." - echo "Sending deployment notification..."
